detail: Full summary: Adversarial policy-leakage review of the proposed twining_triage spec (scratchpad/triage-spec.md). Verified spec claims against src/: reversible absent from DecisionIndexEntry confirmed; found 7 defects — no exit path from ratify_queue for approved decisions (no ratified state exists; active is terminal), stakes formula exceeds its own [0,1] contract and encodes contestable policy weights while ignoring native DelegationUrgency, 48h window default contradicts the spec's own §9 table and hides misclassified irreversible decisions after 2 days, §9's 'Related decisions in scope' row misattributes package-generated findings (decisions.ts:342) as consumer-specific, 'ratify' vocabulary is consumer-workflow language baked into API field names, and 'open need' is undefined (no status field on BlackboardEntry; resolution is an emergent relates_to convention). Findings returned as structured output to orchestrator; no code changed.
